text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Bahraini press on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Labour and social affairs minister calls for minimum wage level for private sector employees.
- Bahrain to have investor-friendly law soon, official says.
- Bahrain may set up a network of lower courts outside Manama to ease the growing pressure on the country's main courts.
- Bahrain to host a seminar on insurance in October.
- Bahrain Commercial Facilities Company posts a 773,000 dinar net profit in the first half of 1997, up 26 percent on the previous year.
- Bahrain's prime minister receives a message from his Jordanian counterpart on relations between the two Arab states.
- A Bahraini labour committee discusses proposals to amend labour law, reviews market situation.
